about: Same five-step ladder as reviews.json (see its 'about'). {X} = the name he picks or types; {a}/{plural} = the kind of thing. 'against' marks the other side (the empty square on the card). · 25 Nov 2026 (the owner, after the content check): every way is a phrase the task's own model texts use (the Model and Guided/Sample steps), three alternatives per move, the moves in the models' order, so Basics teaches what the practice shows. · 'example' on a subject: the five sentences finished for its first answer (eg), each starting with its move's first way; Basics shows them on its card (25 Nov 2026, the owner: immediately likeable).
name: Article
how: An article in five sentences, as the model articles do: a question to hook the reader, your view, a moment you remember, what makes it special, and a last thought.
notebook: Write your article about {X} in five sentences, one per slot. Give it a title. Then check:
ticks: My title and first line make you want to read on.
I spoke to the reader directly.
I told a little story or gave an example.
My ending leaves the reader with a thought.

subjects.label: A hobby
example: Who has never wanted to try something a little dangerous?
For me personally, skateboarding is the best hobby in the world.
I'll never forget the time I landed my first trick in front of my friends.
What makes it so special is that you can do it almost anywhere.
In short, there's something truly unforgettable about skateboarding.

subjects.label: A place
example: Who has never dreamed of a perfect day by the sea?
For me personally, the beach is the best place to relax.
I'll never forget the time we watched the sunset at Praia Formosa.
What makes it so special is the sound of the waves.
In short, there's something truly unforgettable about the beach.

subjects.label: Food
example: Who has never tasted something and wanted more straight away?
For me personally, pastéis de nata are the best cakes in Portugal.
I'll never forget the time my grandmother taught me how to make them.
What makes it so special is the warm, sweet cream inside.
In short, there's something truly unforgettable about pastéis de nata.

subjects.label: Music
example: Who has never listened to the same song ten times in a row?
For me personally, Taylor Swift writes the best songs of all.
I'll never forget the time I first heard her sing live on TV.
What makes it so special is that her songs tell real stories.
In short, there's something truly unforgettable about Taylor Swift.

subjects.label: An app
example: Who has never opened an app for five minutes and stayed for an hour?
For me personally, TikTok is the most fun app on my phone.
I'll never forget the time my first video got a thousand likes.
What makes it so special is that anyone can be creative on it.
In short, there's something truly unforgettable about TikTok.
